## AudioDevice.Type enum

Audio device type enumeration. Describes the well-known audio device types recognized by this SDK.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
enum Type 
```

## Enumeration Members

|  Member | Value | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  Bluetooth | <code>&quot;bluetooth&quot;</code> | Audio device type representing a Bluetooth device. |
|  Earpiece | <code>&quot;earpiece&quot;</code> | Audio device type representing an earpiece. |
|  Speaker | <code>&quot;speaker&quot;</code> | Audio device type representing a speaker. |
|  Unknown | <code>&quot;unknown&quot;</code> | Audio device type representing a device that is not recognized as one of the other well-known [AudioDevice.Type](./voice-react-native-sdk.audiodevice_namespace.type_enum.md) values. |

## Remarks

The native layer can report device types outside of this enumeration, for example due to OS updates introducing new device categories. In those cases, the [AudioDevice](./voice-react-native-sdk.audiodevice_class.md) `type` property is [AudioDevice.Type.Unknown](./voice-react-native-sdk.audiodevice_namespace.type_enum.md) and [AudioDevice.nativeType](./voice-react-native-sdk.audiodevice_class.nativetype_property.md) carries the raw, unprocessed value.
